annotations.title: Measure the wrist and try watches on

description: For a person who does not know their wrist size, or wants to see watches on their own wrist. Makes a link, with a QR code for a computer, that opens on their phone: the back camera measures the wrist in a few seconds with no tape or coin, then draws each watch on a photo of their own wrist at true size, to switch between. Nothing of the picture leaves the phone; tapping Send shares only the size and the watch they liked, which get_try_on_result returns with the code. Up to three watches; the link works for an hour. A picture of each watch can come as a link in image_url (a cutout with a transparent background, or the maker's or a shop's product photo on a plain white or grey background, which WORN cuts out) or as an uploaded file in photos; WORN shows it on the wrist at true size in place of its drawing.

photos.description: Pictures of the watches the person uploaded, straight on, to draw on their wrist in place of the drawing: a cutout, or the watch on a plain background, which WORN cuts out

download_url.description: The file's download URL, as ChatGPT gives it

file_id.description: The file's id, as ChatGPT gives it

watch.description: The name of the watch in the picture, as given in watches; left out, the pictures go to the watches in order

case_mm.description: Case diameter in mm (width, for a square case), if you know it; it picks the right size where the model comes in several. Leave out and WORN uses its catalogue

image_case_px.description: Width in pixels of the case in that picture, edge to edge without the crown (40 to 4000), if you know it; left out, WORN measures it from the watch's outline

image_url.description: https link to the best picture you have of this exact watch, seen from the front, straight on, 12 o'clock up and the crown to the right (PNG, WebP or JPEG). Best is a cutout with a transparent background; a product photo on a plain white or grey background works too, as WORN cuts the watch out of it. WORN draws it on the person's own wrist at true size; a watch shot on a wrist, at an angle or on a busy background is drawn from its sizes instead

lug_to_lug_mm.description: Lug-to-lug span in mm from the maker's specs, if you know it. WORN's catalogue does not hold it: left out, it is estimated at 1.2 times the case and said to be

name.description: The watch's brand and model as the person would say them, e.g. 'Tudor Black Bay 58' or 'Omega Seamaster Diver 300M'. WORN looks it up in its catalogue of 46,000 watches

note.description: One short line on why you suggest this watch, shown under it

thickness_mm.description: Case thickness in mm, if you know it; WORN's catalogue fills it where it can

name: start_try_on
title: Measure the wrist and try watches on
